homework-pass.context: A ticket with notched sides and a crossed out pencil, the reward card that lets a student skip one homework task. Used in classroom reward systems, behaviour charts, teacher stores and school apps.

buddy-bench.context: A playground bench with a heart on its backrest. Children sit on it to show they want someone to play with. Used for recess, anti bullying, friendship and kindness programmes.

brag-tags.context: A ball chain necklace hung with a star, a heart and a round tag. Students collect these tags as rewards for achievements and behaviour. Used in reward systems, classroom incentives and school apps.

graduation-yard-sign.context: A lawn sign on wire stakes printed with a mortarboard and a line for the class year. Placed in front yards to celebrate a graduate. Used for graduation parties, senior celebrations and school event pages.

graduation-bunting.context: A string of pennants hung above a mortarboard. Shown for graduation party decorations, prom and leavers events, and school celebration invitations.

exam-admit-card.context: A card with a header bar, a photo box and a barcode, the pass students bring into an exam hall. Used for exam registration, hall tickets, test centre entry and student portals.

coordinate-grid.context: A grid crossed by x and y axes with arrowheads and one plotted point in the top right quadrant. Used in maths lessons, graphing tools, geometry worksheets and function plotting apps.

rain-cloud-in-a-jar.context: A jar of water topped with a foam cloud and drops falling through the water. The classic shaving cream rain cloud experiment for weather lessons. Used in science lessons, activity plans and kids experiment guides.

magic-milk-experiment.context: A plate of milk with dots of colour and a cotton swab touching the centre, the magic milk experiment where soap makes colours burst apart. Used in kids science activities, lesson plans and stem guides.

dancing-raisins.context: A tall glass of fizzy water with raisins lifted by bubbles. The dancing raisins experiment shows how gas bubbles change buoyancy. Used in science lessons, kids experiment guides and stem activity lists.

cartesian-diver.context: A capped bottle of water with a small pipette diver inside and arrows showing the bottle being squeezed. The Cartesian diver demonstrates pressure and buoyancy. Used in physics lessons and science activity guides.

balloon-hovercraft.context: A flat disc with a bottle cap and a blown up balloon on top, the balloon hovercraft that glides on a cushion of air. Used for stem projects, science fair ideas and lessons on friction and forces.

foil-boat-challenge.context: A small foil boat floating on water and loaded with stacks of coins. Students build the boat to hold as many coins as possible before it sinks. Used for stem challenges, engineering lessons and science clubs.

school-bus-stop-sign.context: A sign on a pole showing a school bus and a child waiting beside it. Marks where students are picked up and dropped off. Used in school transport information, route maps and parent apps.

fiber-optic-lamp.context: A lamp base with a fountain of fine fibre strands that glow at their tips. Common in sensory rooms and calm corners. Used for sensory room equipment lists, special education resources and night light products.

gait-trainer.context: A wheeled walking frame with a padded chest support and a seat sling that holds a child upright while learning to walk. Used in special education, physiotherapy, mobility equipment and accessibility resources.

classroom-fm-system.context: A teacher's lanyard microphone sending signal waves to a listener's ear. The FM or remote microphone system carries the teacher's voice straight to a student's hearing aid or receiver. Used for hearing support and assistive listening.

tray-storage-unit.context: A cabinet of shallow pull out trays on castors with one tray slid half open. Used for classroom storage, student work trays, art supplies and school furniture catalogues.

rain-boot-rack.context: A pair of rain boots standing on a rack off the floor to dry. Used for cloakroom and mudroom signs, outdoor learning kit lists and weather ready reminders.

randoseru.context: A boxy, stiff school backpack with a rounded flap lid and a clasp at the front, the traditional backpack of Japanese primary school children. Used in school supply lists, travel and culture content and shopping apps.

pouring-practice.context: A tray with two small jugs, one tilted and pouring beads into the other. A practical life exercise that builds hand control. Used in Montessori classrooms, early years activity plans and fine motor skill resources.

egg-carton-seedlings.context: An egg carton with a small seedling growing from each soil filled cup. A recycled seed starting project for school gardens. Used in science lessons, gardening activities and eco crafts.

pinecone-bird-feeder.context: A seed coated pinecone hanging from a string with a small bird perched on it. A simple nature craft for feeding garden birds. Used in outdoor learning, winter crafts and wildlife activities.

lunchbox-note.context: A folded note with a heart doodle placed beside a sandwich, the small message parents tuck into a packed lunch. Used for parenting apps, back to school content and family reminders.

finger-counting.context: A hand holding up three fingers beside the number 3. Shows counting on fingers in early maths. Used for number lessons, counting games, early years resources and learning apps.

whisper-phone.context: A child's head in profile with a curved tube running from ear to mouth, the whisper phone that lets readers hear themselves read softly. Used in phonics lessons, reading centres and literacy resources.

reading-finger-pointer.context: A thin wand with a small pointing hand at its tip resting on a line of text. Early readers use it to track words one by one. Used in guided reading, phonics lessons and literacy resources.

leveled-reader.context: A thin picture book with a letter level badge in a circle on the cover corner. Levelled books match reading difficulty to each student. Used in guided reading, school libraries and reading assessment tools.

question-parking-lot.context: A board drawn as a parking lot with sticky notes parked in the bays and a question mark above. Students park questions there to answer later. Used in lesson planning, meetings and classroom routines.

brain-break.context: A brain with small running legs underneath, the short movement break that helps students refocus. Used for classroom routines, timers, energizer activities and wellbeing resources.

wobble-stool.context: A round seat stool on a single post with a rocking base and tilt arcs. Lets fidgety students move while they sit. Used for flexible seating plans, active classrooms and school furniture catalogues.
